# Changelog

## [0.1.0](https://github.com/langwatch/scenario/tree/go/v0.1.0) (2026-04-09)

### Features

* Initial release of the Scenario Go SDK
* Provider-agnostic agent testing framework
* Built-in user simulator and judge agents
* Script DSL: User(), Agent(), Judge(), Proceed(), Succeed(), Fail()
* OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and AWS Bedrock provider adapters
* LangWatch integration for real-time trace reporting
* OpenTelemetry tracing support
